title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Report layout subtype on Word layouts
summary: Word layout report design in Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces a new Subtype property that allows layouts to be specified as Default, HeaderFooter, Theme, or Body. This enables creation of composite layouts where body layouts reference separate header/footer and theme parts, improving flexibility in report formatting and branding.
key_points: Subtype property on Word layouts supports four values: Default, HeaderFooter, Theme, and Body
Theme layouts must use dotx file extension, while Default and Body use docx files
Body layouts enable composite designs by referencing separate HeaderFooter and Theme parts
New Manage themes and header-footer layouts page displays layouts with HeaderFooter and Theme subtypes
